name: shape r0 Nick verbatim
description: It's a V-shape neuron: pointed things drive it and round ones push it negative, whatever the label.

name: shape r0 pointed vs round
description: Pointed things make it fire; round things don't.

name: shape r0 head tapering eye to nose
description: Fires where a head tapers from the eyes to a pointed nose tip; flat or blunt faces stay off.

name: shape r1.1
description: Fires on a head-on face with two eyes above a nose, or a long low wedge tapering to a front tip; profiles stay off.

name: shape r1.2
description: Fires on frontal faces where two eyes and a nose form a triangle under upright pointed ears; droopy ears don't.

name: shape r1.3
description: Fires on long low shapes with a wedge front or on forward-facing faces; tall vertical shapes stay off.

name: shape r1.4
description: Fires when two eyes look straight out over a short nose, or a low front edge points sideways; side-on snouts don't.

name: shape r1.5
description: Fires on a face with symmetric eyes and ears converging to a nose, seen from the front; profile heads stay off.

name: shape r1.6
description: Fires on symmetric front views of a head or a long low streamlined side; upright spikes and side snouts stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.1
description: Fires on a front-facing face whose eyes sit above a V-shaped muzzle point; side-on beaks or snouts stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.2
description: Fires on wedges: a long shape tapering to a low pointed front, or a face narrowing to a nose; round blobs stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.3
description: Fires on V-shaped faces: eyes and ears converging to a small nose tip; flat, round or side-on heads stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.4
description: Fires on a front-on triangle: wide eyes over a downward nose tip; profile or round heads stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.5
description: Fires when edges taper to a point at the front of a long low shape or a face; spires and round shapes stay off.

name: shape spirit r2.6
description: Fires on points set into curves: a pointed front or nose tip on a rounded body; spiky or pure round shapes off.

name: shape r2.1
description: Fires on a head with two upright pointed ears or a long tapering tip; drooping ears and blunt round heads stay off.

name: shape r2.2
description: Fires on triangular ears or block corners seen at an angle; drooping ears, round heads and flat fronts stay off.

name: shape r2.3
description: Fires on V shapes pointing up from a head (ears) or sideways (tips, wedges, corners); low rounded heads stay off.

name: shape r2.4
description: Fires on a narrow head with pointed nose and pointed ears, or a jutting angled corner; dome heads stay off.

name: shape r2.5
description: Fires on angular outlines at a slant: pricked ears, a tapering nose or slanted edges; round fronts stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.1
description: Fires on sharp corners and wedges: angled box fronts, upright pointed ears; droopy, domed or blob shapes stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.2
description: Fires when straight edges meet in angles or converge to a tip; drooping, sagging or all-curved outlines stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.3
description: Fires on upward points: erect ears, angled corners, peaked tops; hanging ears and low flat shapes stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.4
description: Fires on large crisp V or wedge outlines filling the view; small, droopy or round-domed shapes stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.5
description: Fires when points and straight edges outweigh curves: pointy ears, angular fronts, corners; curvy shapes stay off.

name: shape spirit r3.6
description: Fires on symmetric V outlines: twin raised ear tips or a tapered front; hanging ears and rounded heads stay off.

name: shape spirit r4.1
description: Fires on long low shapes tapering at the ends or faces narrowing to a nose; droopy, broad or round shapes off.

name: shape spirit r4.2
description: Fires on converging lines: angled box corners, tapering long sides, a face narrowing to a nose; blobs stay off.

name: shape spirit r4.3
description: Fires when outlines converge: wedge fronts, angled corners, pointed ears or nose; droopy ears and domes stay off.

name: shape spirit r4.4
description: Fires on V-faces or long tapering sides; broad heads with hanging ears, squat flat shapes and round blobs stay off.

name: shape spirit r4.5
description: Fires on large V-shapes: tapered long sides, angled box corners, narrow faces; tiny, droopy or round shapes off.

name: shape spirit r4.6
description: Fires on wedge outlines with straight converging edges; heads wider than long, hanging ears and domes stay off.

name: shape r3.1
description: Fires on heads with pointed ears or a tapering muzzle, and on long low boxes; droopy round heads stay off.

name: shape r3.2
description: Fires when sharp points jut from a head (ears, snout tip) or a low wide box has a sloped front; round tops off.

name: shape r3.3
description: Fires on upright pointed ears framing eyes, or long thin pointed tips; round or droopy-eared heads stay off.

name: shape r3.4
description: Fires on wide horizontal shapes with crisp corners or angled edges, or heads with pointy ears; round blobs off.

name: shape r3.5
description: Fires where two straight edges meet in a V: ear tips, snout tips, box corners; smooth-arc outlines stay off.

name: shape r3.6
description: Fires on a narrow tapered head with peaked ears or a slim tip, or a flat low edge; broad, hanging-eared heads off.
